name: team_game_logs
description: Team box scores, one row per team per game.
leakage_risk: NA

name: season_id
description: hoopR's raw season identifier (e.g. '22022'), distinct from the human-readable 'season' column.
leakage_risk: safe

name: team_id
description: Team's NBA Stats API identifier.
leakage_risk: safe

name: team_abbreviation

leakage_risk: safe (metadata only)

name: team_name

leakage_risk: safe (metadata only)

name: game_id_nba
